verdicts.note: Teenage childbearing and school dropout in Cameroon.
No abstract; systematic review of family demographic processes and in-work poverty.
HOUSEHOLD STRUCTURE against becoming a 'nini' across 12 Latin American countries. Arrangement as exposure, disengagement as outcome.

Published EDCC version of the reclassified anchor: an ARGENTINE PENSION REFORM inducing exogenous variation in grandmothers' retirement, against daughters' employment. Well identified, but the exposure is the grandmother's time and the outcome is labour supply -- both route-outs.
No abstract; grandparent-grandchild relationships and older people's wellbeing in Chile.
No abstract; a proposed questionnaire on the educational lifecycle and the transition to adulthood. Instrument design rather than evidence.

Fifty years of US children's household composition in the PSID, including the FREQUENCY OF FAMILY MEMBERS' ENTRANCES AND DEPARTURES. Turnover rather than stock -- a measurement §9 should adopt, since co-residence is not an absorbing state.
Law and psychiatric problems in the elderly.
Family planning policy and old-age care in China. C.3.c's.
Life-course gender gap in caregiving in the US.
Network analysis of single-parent household COVID policy.
Dynamic microsimulation methods.

Grandparental support and the division of housework in Italy, noting that grandparent AVAILABILITY affects young couples' labour participation and fertility decisions. C.2.a's exposure, housework outcome.
Credit card ownership correlates.
Review of the missing-women literature. D.2.c's.
Caregivers of children with medical complexity.
Emerging living arrangements of older adults in India.

No abstract, but the title puts CO-RESIDENCE rather than care in the exposure: 'How Grandparents' CORESIDENCE Affects the Relationship Between Fertility and Parental Labor Market Choices: Evidence From China'. If it holds, this is an extended-arm record rather than a C.2.a one, and it addresses the fertility/labour-supply joint outcome directly. Priority trace.

Transition to adulthood in poor rural Appalachia under persistent poverty and the opioid crisis, with strong family and work norms. An EXPEDITED rather than delayed transition -- the mirror case, and a useful contrast to the Southern European pattern.
Pregnancy during otolaryngology residency.
Annual Review of Sociology on Latin American family dynamics, union formation and fertility. Regional framing for a region the frame reaches thinly.
No abstract; state parent registry laws.

Spatial Bayesian modelling of HOUSEHOLD COMPOSITION against municipal FERTILITY levels across MEXICO in 2020. An ecological design, so it inherits the inference problem, but it is an arrangement-to-fertility estimate at sub-national resolution in a Latin American setting the frame otherwise lacks.
No abstract; published version of 'Fertility cost, grandparental childcare, and female employment'.
Parental repartnering and child wellbeing, distinguishing residential from nonresidential partnerships. Co-residence with a partner; child outcome.
Social gradients in KIN AVAILABILITY across the life course in Sweden, from registers. Kin availability is the constraint on the extended arm's exposure, now measured with a class gradient.
Wellbeing of adolescents conceived through medically assisted reproduction. A.17's.

Migration aspirations and ideal age at union formation in western Mexico, with HOUSEHOLD FORMATION named among the sequenced behaviours migration systems shape. Migration as a route out of the parental home in a Latin American setting.

EMPLOYMENT PROTECTION LEGISLATION and HOUSEHOLD FORMATION in Italy, examining how EPL CHANGES alter young people's intentions. A legal reform as the source of variation on link 1, in the registered setting, and the paper notes nobody had looked at EPL for these outcomes before. Design 6's shape from the labour-law side; C.5.a owns the treatment.
Guidelines for surgery in pregnancy.
Early life transitions and depressed mood over 27 years in Norway.
Pregnancy care for women with type 1 diabetes in China.
UK households and time at home during the pandemic; the birth rate is reported as a coincident trend.
No abstract; published JCE version of the Cool Water paper. D.2.a's.

STATE LOTTERY WINS against HOMEOWNERSHIP, MARRIAGE AND FERTILITY for young adults, on the universe of US tax data 2000-2019. As clean an exogenous financial shock as exists, with all three lifecycle outcomes estimated together. The exposure is money rather than the arrangement, so C.3.e owns it -- but it bounds how much of the housing-fertility link is pure liquidity, which the Wall 1 read needs.

THREE-GENERATION living arrangements in HUNGARY from censuses 1980-2016, with determinants. Central and Eastern Europe, and the 1990-2001 interruption in the decline is a natural discontinuity worth reading about.

'Long goodbyes': pathways of LEAVING HOME in SPAIN, separating moving out TO LIVE WITH A PARTNER from moving out WITHOUT one. That separation is what makes the arrangement analytically distinct from union formation -- the single most useful distinction for keeping A.23 apart from A.7, in the registered setting.
Intergenerational co-residence and COVID-19 contagion among Europeans over 50, SHARE.
Literary essay; 'Home Trap' is a metaphor.
No abstract; state tuition benefits for undocumented students. C.3.b's.
Interview on Nepal's family planning programme. A.5's.
eHealth cardiac rehabilitation adherence.

Marriage, motherhood and female mobility in Bronze and Iron Age central Europe, where PATRILOCAL RESIDENCE is the standard explanation for isotopically traced female movement. Archaeological evidence on the residence rule itself.
Seminar volume on micro-approaches to demographic research.
No abstract; union experience and stability of parental unions in Sweden and Norway. A.7's.
Encyclopedia entry on economics and family structures.
Marriage and widowhood in nineteenth-century Transylvania.
No abstract; Iranian immigrants' integration in Israel.
Whether GRANDPARENTAL CHILDCARE mediates or moderates the religiosity-fertility association, GGS. C.2.a's exposure, though the mediation framing is close to this chapter's.
Naldini's five-cluster typology of European family change, including the Mediterranean group. The regime classification the pre-launch arm's cross-national records rely on.
Intergenerational transmission of family dissolution by class origin.
No abstract; household energy consumption in China.
No abstract; latent profile and transition analysis of adult social roles in RURAL AMERICA. Companion to the Appalachian record.
Child and Dependent Care Credit for adult dependants.
Scoping review of parental-leave policy in surgical residency.
